prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has suffered injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any electronic records associated with the incident. Please take steps to ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or repaired without notice to this office.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
